Title: Azure Backup Price and Meter ID Change - ZA North and ZA West regions of South Africa

Body.Content:
Effective December 1, 2020, the price and meter IDs (also known as Resource GUIDs) of Azure Backup will change in the ZA North and ZA West regions of South Africa. Review new pricing details. If you have any billing routines that rely on resource GUIDs, you will need to modify them. See the linked table below for the impacted resource GUIDs.

Azure Backup - GUID Change
